name: move_id_links
note: stock.move.never_product_template_attribute_value_ids many2many owner (addons/stock/models/stock_move.py:47): never-attribute values per move with the lowest value id
source_sql: SELECT move_id, count(*) AS links, min(template_attribute_value_id) AS first_template_attribute_value_id FROM template_attribute_value_stock_move_rel GROUP BY move_id ORDER BY move_id

name: template_attribute_value_id_links
